# SK Fashion Studio

> Designer boutique in Velachery, Chennai. Bespoke bridal blouses with Aari, Maggam and Zardosi embroidery, designer blouse stitching, lehenga tailoring, saree transformation and custom ladies tailoring. Personal fittings by founder Karuna Kumari.

Key facts: Located at B Park Avenue Street, 30A Sheshadripuram 1st Main Rd, Sheshadripuram, Velachery, Chennai 600042. Open Mon–Sat 10:30–20:30 (Sunday by appointment). Phone +91 98840 16637. WhatsApp consultations available.

## Services
- [Bridal Blouses & Couture](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Aari/Maggam/Zardosi hand embroidery, two trial fittings, designer latkans
- [Designer Blouse Stitching](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Backless, corset, halter, contemporary cuts for party wear and silk sarees
- [Lehenga Stitching & Choli](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Bridal and festive lehengas with can-can layers
- [Saree Pre-Pleating & Draping](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Professional pre-pleating for Kanchipuram silk and bridal sarees
- [Saree Conversion & Upcycling](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Redesign old sarees into lehengas, gowns, Anarkalis
- [One Minute Saree (Ready-to-Wear)](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Pre-stitched sarees with adjustable waistbands
- [Kids Collection & Pattu Pavadai](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Traditional and festive attire for young girls
- [Hand Embroidery & Aari Work](https://skfashionstudio.in/#services): Bespoke Aari, Zardosi, pearl beading, stone embellishments

## Areas served
Velachery, Madipakkam, Pallikaranai, Adambakkam, Guindy, Alandur, Perungudi, Thoraipakkam, South Chennai
